name: Jillvet Magallan
original_name: ジルヴェット・マガリャン
source:
Priest in service of goddess of love.

Guild Abestaags branch chief in Mareshia. Good friend of Philia and seems to know Falco quite well too. Friendly and easy to get along with. Being member of seraph-race is also quick to fall in love. Below the rather happy-go-luck personality has still deep sense of mission to bring peace to world.

Has elder sister (http://vndb.org/c11365)

[spoiler] Member of Faridoun the special organization tasked hunting down members of beastia [/spoiler]
